title: ARS Sound Agent — Input (Editor edl_ready precondition gate + mode-converged EDL + Ingest asset_bundle audio-resolution reference)
description: Validates the v1.0 input of the Sound Agent (Agent #11 of 17 — the SECOND faithful-executor agent in the post tail: it FINISHES the audio on the cut Editor conformed and makes no creative call; the 11th defense-in-depth firewall pass over the passthrough VO transcript — the last audio checkpoint before Motion; the THIRD contractually mode-BLIND agent — the live proof Ingest's mode-convergence seam holds THREE stages deep: Edit Director -> Editor -> Sound). Authored Day 79 (Tue Jul 7 2026) from SPEC §2/§7 Inputs (Day 74 outline + Day 75 partial 1 §7) + §10 Field Map (Day 75) + §10.3 no-touch rows + §16 metadata block (Day 76 partial 2) + the Day 78 LOCK CANDIDATE reconciliation. TWO defining input characteristics, both inherited from the proven Editor input shape (7th reuse of the precondition-gate + mode-blind pattern): (1) the Editor precondition gate — Sound reads the EDL verdict FIRST and never finishes an unlocked cut (Hard Rule #4 / Step 1 / Check #1); the runtime gate is edl.verdict == 'edl_ready' OR a Lever-3 sign-off attached, else halt upstream_edl_not_ready; a non-successEdl output_type halts upstream_not_success (Check #2). A consumed 'fail'-verdict / errorEnvelope EDL is NOT auto-finished — it needs the Lever-3 sign-off, like any non-pass. (2) mode-BLINDNESS — production_mode is PRESENT in metadata for audit lineage but is a strict no-touch field (§10.3): Sound NEVER reads it as a branch discriminator (Hard Rule #7), and its output attests mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read:false. Like Editor there is NO polymorphic-source oneOf split here — the EDL is already mode-converged (one EDL shape for all three production modes — the TC-01/TC-02 convergence proof three stages deep), so Sound consumes ONE source shape for all modes. Like every prior ARS schema this is single-file (no external $ref resolution): the consumed EDL deep internals are validated by the LOCKED Editor output.schema.json (read-only) and the asset_bundle deep internals by the LOCKED Ingest output.schema.json (read-only); both are left permissive here (additionalProperties true) to avoid canon drift; this schema constrains the finish-relevant envelope + the fields the 11-check self-QC adjudicates. A consumed errorEnvelope (output_type != successEdl) is a runtime halt (upstream_not_success — Check #2), NOT a schema rejection. parent_chain inbound = Editor's 9-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY (minItems 5 accepts the 5-tuple pre-ratification canon; maxItems 9 accepts the QC 6-tuple + Ingest 7-tuple + Edit Director 8-tuple + Editor 9-tuple extension previews; items false). Sound appends its own audio_spec_id at position 9 on OUTPUT (see output.schema.json — 10-tuple, also held additively). TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: when the n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the Editor 9-tuple LOCKs AND the Edit Director 8-tuple LOCKs AND the Ingest 7-tuple LOCKs AND the QC 6-tuple LOCKs, flip inbound to minItems 9 (exact-9). The 9-tuple inbound + 10-tuple outbound are NOT auto-advanced this run (Decision D7 — QUINTUPLY-deferred; Sound is the FIFTH forcing function for the amendment).

edl.description: §2/§7 PRIMARY input + the Editor precondition gate (Hard Rule #4 / Step 1 / Checks #1+#2). Sound reads this FIRST. TWO runtime gates (both halts, NOT schema rejections — a non-edl_ready / errorEnvelope EDL is a valid object, an invalid finish-source): (1) output_type == 'successEdl' else halt upstream_not_success (Check #2 — cannot finish a failed conform output); (2) verdict == 'edl_ready' OR lever3_signoff_present == true else halt upstream_edl_not_ready (Check #1 — a 'fail' verdict with no sign-off is not finishable). Deep EDL internals (the full Editor successEdl payload) are owned by the LOCKED Editor output.schema.json (read-only); only the finish-relevant envelope is constrained here (additionalProperties true). Sound TRUSTS Editor's edl_firewall_pass_10 (the committed caption/lower-third/end-card text was clean at the 10th commit pass — §10.3 no-touch) and runs its OWN 11th firewall pass over the passthrough VO transcript (the spoken-word surface Editor's commit-text pass does not cover).

output_type.description: The Editor output discriminator. Sound proceeds ONLY on 'successEdl'; an inbound errorEnvelope => upstream_not_success at runtime (Check #2). Permissive enum accepts either Editor branch value so the agent can READ + halt on a failed EDL rather than schema-rejecting it.

verdict.description: The upstream Editor verdict (Editor emits edl_ready | fail — two-verdict, NO 'revise'). Sound finishes ONLY on 'edl_ready' OR an attached Lever-3 sign-off; a 'fail' with no sign-off => upstream_edl_not_ready at runtime (Check #1).

lever3_signoff.description: OPTIONAL human Lever-3 sign-off — the ONLY bypass of the edl_ready precondition (Decision D4 inherit). Presence with signoff_present:true permits finish of a non-edl_ready EDL. Absent / null on the normal edl_ready path.

edl_evidence_hash.description: §10 (derived) — Editor's SHA-256 EDL anchor (lowercase hex, 64) over the edl + conform_check + plan_fidelity_check block. Sound RE-VERIFIES it against the consumed EDL body (spec_fidelity_check.edl_evidence_hash_verified); a mismatch => spec_fidelity_breach (route back to Editor). Tamper-evidence carried forward, not re-authored.

conform_check.description: §10 read context — Editor's conform-integrity block. Sound reads total_timeline_ms as the timeline bound every mix/SFX/duck marker at_ms is validated against (Check #4 — no marker past the timeline); a Sound-side audio timeline duration != total_timeline_ms => spec_fidelity_breach. NOT re-adjudicated (Editor already gated the conform).

total_timeline_ms.description: Editor's conformed runtime — the marker-in-timeline bound + the audio-timeline-duration reference.

events.description: §10 — the conformed cut timeline (read-only reference). Sound does NOT re-order, re-trim, or re-time any event (Hard Rule #2 — spec faithfully, re-cut nothing). Read for audio-marker alignment only.

music_event.description: §10 — the music bed at t0 (Editor placed it; Sound finalizes the mix — the swell markers Editor left as placement-only). asset_uri must resolve against asset_bundle.music_bed (else audio_asset_unresolved). swell_markers are copied EXACTLY into the Sound duck_envelope authoring (spec_fidelity_check.swell_markers_match_edl); a deviation => spec_fidelity_breach.

asset_uri.description: Platform-relative ars:// music-bed handle. Must resolve against asset_bundle.music_bed (else audio_asset_unresolved, route to Ingest).

at_ms.description: The bed lays at t0 (Editor's placement, carried faithfully).

swell_markers.description: Editor's swell placement markers — Sound maps each into duck_envelope swell moves, byte-position-faithful (spec_fidelity_check.swell_markers_match_edl). NOT re-placed.

vo_transcript.description: §10 field map — the Script/Editor-authored spoken-word transcript, PASSTHROUGH only (Hard Rule #10 — Sound authors no spoken copy). text is the VO polish reference AND the 11th-firewall scan surface: Sound copies it BYTE-FOR-BYTE (a deviation => spec_fidelity_breach) and walks every text field with the 11-entry canonical firewall list (a banned token => audio_firewall_breach, the GATING §9 TC-05 case). May be absent on a music-only reel.

text.description: PASSTHROUGH byte-faithful (a deviation => spec_fidelity_breach); scanned at the 11th audio-domain firewall pass (a banned token => audio_firewall_breach).

tier_richness_echo.description: §10 read context — the tier's planned loudness-variant count. Sound echoes loudness_variants_planned but v1.0 specs ONLY the primary -14 LUFS master (loudness_variants_specced const 1; the -16 LUFS YT variant is flagged, deferred D14). NOT a verdict fork — finish fidelity is identical across tiers (the §10.5 tier-FLAT matrix).

mode_blind_confirm.description: §10.3 read context — Editor's OWN mode-blind self-attestation (production_mode_read:false). Sound reads it as the upstream convergence proof (two stages deep) and emits its OWN attestation (the THIRD mode-blind agent — convergence three stages deep). NOT re-adjudicated.

render_target.description: §10.3 read context — Editor's no-render / human-in-the-loop attestation. Sound reads render_target.v1_edit_uri (the human's conform handle) as the finish reference; it does NOT dispatch a render (Sound's own finish_target.audio_processed const false is the audio analog).

asset_bundle.description: §10 — the resolved Ingest pull list (the audio-resolution REFERENCE, read-only). audio[] resolves the VO voice track (an unresolvable handle => vo_track_missing, route to Ingest — SPLIT code); music_bed resolves the bed (an unresolvable handle => audio_asset_unresolved, route to Ingest — the OTHER SPLIT code). The two Ingest-routed asset codes are kept SEPARATE (D8 — the deliberate opposite of Editor folding all resolution to one asset_unresolved) because a missing voice track and an unresolvable bed demand different operator recovery actions. NO byte-level audio decode — declared resolution only (Hard Rule #12). Deep internals owned by the LOCKED Ingest output.schema.json (read-only) — left permissive here to avoid canon drift.

audio.description: Flat normalized audio URI list (the VO voice-track resolution reference; sync was already adjudicated at Ingest). An unresolvable handle for a declared VO track => vo_track_missing (route to Ingest).

music_bed.description: The resolvable music-bed handle reference. edl.music_event.asset_uri must resolve against this (or audio[]) else audio_asset_unresolved (route to Ingest).

preflight_report.description: OPTIONAL §10.3 read-only context — denormalized QC Pre-flight cost-ledger reference. Sound carries NO cost fields beyond its own cost_incurred_usd (Hard Rule #11 — no cost re-litigation; the ceilings are QC Pre-flight's jurisdiction, restated for traceability only, never re-adjudicated). Deep internals owned by the QC Pre-flight output.schema.json (read-only).

edlId.description: Editor's emitted identity (UUIDv7 per Cross-SPEC §3.9 ID canon) + the 9th inbound parent_chain element (position 8). UUIDv7 validates under the uuid format. This is the EDL Sound finishes the audio over.

preflightReportId.description: QC Pre-flight's emitted identity + the 6th parent_chain element. v1.0: ^preflight-REINVENTED-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN$ (multi-brand v1.1+ widens the prefix).

sessionId.description: Inbound session identifier. Accepts Cross-SPEC §3.9 UUID(-v7) canon OR the established ars-/sess- prefixed forms (additive, backward-compatible — does not false-reject existing pipeline session ids). Single combined pattern avoids oneOf/format ambiguity (format is annotation-only under Draft 2020-12 default assertion behavior).

inboundParentChainHeld.description: Inbound lineage = Editor's 9-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY. positions 0-7 inherit the Editor inbound chain verbatim (ARS-2026-06-29-Editor-output.schema.json parentChainHeld 0-7); position 8 = the Editor extension (edl_id, UUIDv7). minItems 5 ACCEPTS the 5-tuple pre-ratification canon; maxItems 9 ACCEPTS the QC 6-tuple, Ingest 7-tuple, Edit Director 8-tuple AND Editor 9-tuple extension previews; items false. REJECTS a 4-tuple. Sound validates a well-formed inbound chain (Step 2 / Check #10); malformed => audio_lineage_failure at runtime. Sound appends its own audio_spec_id at position 9 on OUTPUT (see output.schema.json — 10-tuple, also held additively). TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: flip to minItems 9 (exact-9) when the n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the Editor 9-tuple LOCKs AND the Edit Director 8-tuple LOCKs AND the Ingest 7-tuple LOCKs AND the QC Pre-flight 6-tuple LOCKs (Decision D7 — QUINTUPLY-deferred, NOT auto-advanced this run).

inboundMetadataBlock.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 inbound metadata carried from Editor. Sound reads tier (loudness-variant-count awareness — §10.5; NOT verdict forking) / lever_state / parent_chain (9-tuple, held) / brand_id for context. production_mode is PRESENT for audit lineage but is a strict NO-TOUCH field (§10.3 / Hard Rule #7) — NEVER read as a branch discriminator; the output attests mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read:false (the third mode-blind agent). There is NO source-shape oneOf in this schema BECAUSE the EDL is already mode-converged.

tier.description: Universal access — ALL 4 tiers traverse Sound at ~$0 (§4 / tier-FLAT). Finish fidelity does NOT scale by tier; only the echoed loudness_variants_planned count does (§10.5).

production_mode.description: Carried for audit lineage ONLY. NOT read as a branch (Hard Rule #7 / §10.3). The output's mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read:false attests it was never consulted — the third mode-blind agent, convergence three stages deep.
